scope: Static separate custody/material contract, not physical custody enforcement

classes: Authenticated private TEST server-endpoint identity; distinct observer keys sign probe witnesses, never impersonate postmaster
Slot/generation/purpose-bound TEST Ed25519 transport key; one-use work authorization separate from bounded heartbeat authentication
proof.proof: POSTMASTER public expected endpoint manifest is not another slot private signing key. Other slots have distinct recipient/role/purpose/generation-bound material. Same credential class/format does not imply same bytes.

contracts.CUSTODIAN: HOST-held expected server endpoint authentication manifest, no fabricated POSTMASTER message key
contracts.DELIVERY_CHANNEL: Dedicated inherited sealed FD4 or server-endpoint expected manifest for POSTMASTER
contracts.DELIVERY_AUTHENTICATION: Exact retained parent/child birth and immutable bootstrap inventory
contracts.STORAGE_POLICY: Private slot UID only, sealed memfd, no host paths/env/argv/log export
contracts.MEMORY_RESIDENCE_POLICY: Import before ACTIVE, non-dumpable private memory, no ptrace/proc access; fixed bounded buffers zeroized after retirement
contracts.PERSISTENCE_POLICY: No private key disk persistence; public SPKI/digest/tombstone only
contracts.USE_COUNT: One accepted work authorization; duplicate returns same receipt. Separate heartbeat purpose has finite approved frame count
contracts.EXPIRY_RULE: Exact immutable native policy BOOTTIME bound and current boot/timens; current generation/enrollment mandatory, no TTL renewal
contracts.GENERATION_BINDING: Exact current slot/generation high-water, no fallback
contracts.REVOCATION_AUTHORITY: NATIVE_REGISTRY_WRITER applies exact invalidation; HOST controls custody teardown
contracts.CRASH_BEHAVIOR: UNKNOWN, no reissue of same live authority
contracts.RESTART_BEHAVIOR: New generation/key only after old reconciliation/extinction/tombstone
contracts.LEAK_OR_THEFT_BEHAVIOR: Quarantine entire affected generation; retire key/channel; stolen bytes alone cannot match required current kernel sender anchor
contracts.REPLAY_BEHAVIOR: Deny used challenge/stale generation/context; identical terminal receipt read only
contracts.DESTRUCTION_OR_ZEROIZATION_REQUIREMENT: Close import descriptor, explicit secret buffer cleanse on retirement; absence of destruction witness UNKNOWN

contracts.CRASH_BEHAVIOR: UNKNOWN, no reissue of same live authority
contracts.RESTART_BEHAVIOR: New generation/key only after old reconciliation/extinction/tombstone

contracts.REPLAY_BEHAVIOR: Deny used challenge/stale generation/context; identical terminal receipt read only

contracts.USE_COUNT: One accepted work authorization; duplicate returns same receipt. Separate heartbeat purpose has finite approved frame count

contracts.GENERATION_BINDING: Exact current slot/generation high-water, no fallback
contracts.REVOCATION_AUTHORITY: NATIVE_REGISTRY_WRITER applies exact invalidation; HOST controls custody teardown
contracts.CRASH_BEHAVIOR: UNKNOWN, no reissue of same live authority
contracts.RESTART_BEHAVIOR: New generation/key only after old reconciliation/extinction/tombstone
contracts.LEAK_OR_THEFT_BEHAVIOR: Quarantine entire affected generation; retire key/channel; stolen bytes alone cannot match required current kernel sender anchor
contracts.REPLAY_BEHAVIOR: Deny used challenge/stale generation/context; identical terminal receipt read only
contracts.DESTRUCTION_OR_ZEROIZATION_REQUIREMENT: Close import descriptor, explicit secret buffer cleanse on retirement; absence of destruction witness UNKNOWN
